name: @local/skill-manager
description: 技能仓库 · Machine-wide AI skill library manager for the DeepSeek Harness: discover, categorize, install, and remove skills across every AI tool on the machine.
//: All @deepseek-ai runtime packages are provided by the DeepSeek Harness installation. A linked profile bundle may only import a DSH package that it declares as a peerDependency, so every one of them is declared here and none is a hard dependency. The @local/ scope reflects a link-based local install into a DSH profile (see README); the project source lives in this repository.
